name: Koom Nang Kruan
original_name: คุ้มนางครวญ
overview: This lakorn tells a story from the past and from the present: Toomtam plays both Luang Thep (the past) and Thripope (the present) and his character will be haunted by a female ghost (Pinky) who seeks revenge. Will she destroy him and his future with another woman (Mo)?
